title: stage-times draws nail's stage tree for mgy and pid side by side
body:
`benchmarks/stage-times` runs nail once per unit with `-s`, keeps the stage tree nail prints under `results/nail.<unit>.stats`, and `parse` writes `stages.tbl` and `counts.tbl` for its two labels, `mgy` and `pid`. Both real labels have run and parsed. The crate has no `plot` command, and CLAUDE.md lists it among the benchmarks that stop at `parse`.

## Proposal
A `plot` command and a script under `scripts/` that draw the two labels' trees side by side, so a stage's share of nail's wall clock on MGnify reads against its share on the profmark set.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Built benchmarks/stage-times: run and parse over two labels, mgy (cross, Pfam against 500k MGnify) and pid (the profmark set at pid's parameters), each with a toy. nail runs once per unit with -s and stdout kept in results/nail.<unit>.stats. parse writes stages.tbl (unit, parent, stage, secs, share, wall) where a leaf's wall is its share of its branch's wall, per Jack's approximation, and counts.tbl. Both toys run end to end in the sandbox with hits. No plot yet; the figure is meant to put the two labels side by side. Real runs not yet done.
